= Item and Spell Icon Reference =
Browse uploaded item and spell icons, 100 at a time, or find an exact ID. Select an icon to open its file page.

New item icons retain their game-pack IDs as <code>Item_ID.png</code>. Existing wiki files and references are preserved. Identical artwork can have several IDs; this list shows every filename, while the editor's Icon Finder groups identical artwork and lets you choose its ID.

<div id="eql-icon-catalog">Loading icon catalog…</div>

If the catalog is unavailable, use [[Special:ListFiles|the uploaded file list]]. Legacy spell icons retain their original letter or numeric IDs.
